#### Defining Functions
```{r Load_CorMotif_Functions, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#Run the Function corMotifcustom.R

#Check_Overlap Function

check_overlap <- function(list_of_lists) {
  # create empty list to store results
  overlap_results <- list()
  
  # loop over each cluster
  for (i in seq_along(list_of_lists)) {
    cluster_name <- names(list_of_lists)[i]
    genes_i <- list_of_lists[[i]]
    
    # compare to all other clusters
    overlaps <- sapply(seq_along(list_of_lists), function(j) {
      if (i == j) return(NA)  # skip self
      genes_j <- list_of_lists[[j]]
      length(intersect(genes_i, genes_j))  # count of overlapping genes
    })
    names(overlaps) <- names(list_of_lists)
    
    overlap_results[[cluster_name]] <- overlaps
  }
  
  return(overlap_results)
}

#FC_Plot_Function_sig

plot_cluster_fc_sig <- function(gene_vector, cluster_name, top_table) {

  df <- top_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_vector) %>%
    mutate(Comparisons = factor(Comparisons, levels = c(
      "H_Day02","H_Day25","H_Day515","H_Day1530","C_Day02","C_Day25","C_Day515","C_Day1530"
    )))

  cat(cluster_name, ":", nrow(df), "rows,",
      length(unique(df$Gene)), "unique genes\n")

  # Global test across comparisons
  kw <- kruskal.test(logFC ~ Comparisons, data = df)
  
  pw_kw <-pairwise.wilcox.test(
    df$logFC,
    df$Comparisons,
    p.adjust.method = "BH")
  
  print(pw_kw)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = logFC)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Comparisons)) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(" ") +
    ylab("logFC") +
    ggtitle(
      paste0(
        cluster_name,
        " RNA FC Comparisons\nKruskal–Wallis p = ",
        signif(kw$p.value, 3)
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.3), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 15)
    )

  return(p)


}

#AbsFC_Plot_Function

plot_cluster_absfc <- function(gene_vector, cluster_name, top_table) {
  
  # Filter TopTable for the genes in this cluster
  df <- top_table %>% dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_vector) %>%
    mutate(Comparisons = factor(Comparisons, levels = c(
      "HC_D0","HC_D2","HC_D5","HC_D15","HC_D30"
    )))
  
  # Optional: print dimensions and unique genes
  cat(cluster_name, ":", dim(df)[1], "rows,", length(unique(df$Gene)), "unique genes\n")
  
  # Create boxplot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = AbsFC)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Comparisons)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Comparisons")) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(" ") +
    ylab("AbsFC") +
    ggtitle(paste0(cluster_name, " RNA AbsFC Comparisons")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.5), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#CAD899"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, colour = "white", angle = 15),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold")
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

### Modeling on Laptop

#### Data Preparation
```{r RNA-Seq_No4_CorMotif_Trajectory_Modeling_computer,fig.height=8,fig.width=15}
counts <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No4.RDS")
metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata_No4_NoRep.RDS")

counts_norep <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-(contains("R")))

log2cpm <- cpm(counts_norep, log=TRUE) 


# --- Align metadata and log2cpm
metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(log2cpm), metadata$SampleName), ]

# --- Build group and comp IDs from metadata ---
metadata$group <- paste(metadata$Species, metadata$Timepoint, sep = "_")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30")
species_order <- c("H","C")

group_levels <- c(paste("H",time_order,sep = "_"), paste("C",time_order, sep = "_"))

metadata$group <- factor(metadata$group, levels = group_levels, ordered = TRUE)

groupid <- as.numeric(metadata$group)

make_trajectory <- function(levels_vec, prefix, times) {
  target <- paste(prefix, times, sep = "_")
  idx <- match(target, levels_vec)
  idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]
  cbind(idx[-length(idx)], idx[-1])
}

compid <- rbind(
  make_trajectory(levels(metadata$group), "H", time_order),
  make_trajectory(levels(metadata$group), "C", time_order)
)
```

#### PPost

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_CorMotif_Trajectory_TACC_PPost}
motif.fitted <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/TACC/Trajectory/CorMotif_k1_k20_seed8_No4.rds")

counts <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No4.RDS")

counts_norep <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-(contains("R")))

log2cpm <- cpm(counts_norep, log=TRUE) 

motif.fit <- motif.fitted
log2cpm <- log2cpm

TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")

#extract the posterior probability that these genes belong to motifs
gene_prob_ppost <- motif.fit$bestmotif$p.post
rownames(gene_prob_ppost) <- rownames(log2cpm)
saveRDS(gene_prob_ppost,"data/Cormotif/Trajectory/RNA_gene_prob_ppost_Trajectory.RDS")

#assign each gene to a motif with max post prob
assigned_motifs <- apply(gene_prob_ppost, 1, which.max)
max_probs <- apply(gene_prob_ppost, 1, max)

#combine these into a dataframe - motif assigned genes (p.post)
motif_assignment_df <- gene_prob_ppost %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Assigned_Motif = assigned_motifs[Gene],
    Max_Probability = max_probs[Gene]
  )

#make some histograms of the unfiltered data from Cormotif p.post

gene_prob_ppost %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = V1))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)+
  xlim(0,1)+
  ggtitle("Cormtif p.post RNA V1")

gene_prob_ppost %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = V2))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)+
  xlim(0,1)+
  ggtitle("Cormtif p.post RNA V2")

gene_prob_ppost %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = V3))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 50)+
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_CorMotif_Trajectory_TACC_ClusterAssign2}

# ============================================================
# CorMotif posterior probability / gene assignment analysis
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Maximum posterior probability for each gene
# ------------------------------------------------------------

max_prob <- apply(motif_prob, 1, max)

# Basic summary
summary(max_prob)

quantile(
  max_prob,
  probs = c(
    0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75,
    0.90, 0.95, 0.99, 1
  )
)

# Histogram
hist(
  max_prob,
  breaks = 50,
  xlab = "Maximum CorMotif posterior probability",
  main = "Maximum posterior probability per gene"
)

abline(v = 0.5, lty = 2)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Check that CorMotif probabilities sum to ~1
# ------------------------------------------------------------

prob_sums <- rowSums(motif_prob)

summary(prob_sums)

# Optional stricter check
all(abs(prob_sums - 1) < 1e-6)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sort posterior probabilities for each gene
#    This gives the top and second-best cluster
# ------------------------------------------------------------

posterior_sorted <- t(
  apply(
    motif_prob,
    1,
    sort,
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create one complete gene-assignment table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

motif_assignment <- data.frame(
  Gene = rownames(motif_prob),
  MaxProb = posterior_sorted[, 1],
  SecondProb = posterior_sorted[, 2],
  Cluster = apply(motif_prob, 1, which.max)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Margin = MaxProb - SecondProb,

    Assignment = ifelse(
      MaxProb > 0.5,
      paste0("Cluster_", Cluster),
      "Unassigned"
    ),

    Confidence = case_when(
      MaxProb > 0.7 ~ "High",
      MaxProb > 0.5 ~ "Moderate",
      MaxProb > 0.4 ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ "Unassigned"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Number and percentage assigned at different thresholds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

thresholds <- c(
  0.3,
  0.4,
  0.5,
  0.6,
  0.7,
  0.8,
  0.9
)

threshold_summary <- data.frame(
  Threshold = thresholds,
  N_assigned = sapply(
    thresholds,
    function(x) sum(max_prob > x)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent_assigned =
      100 * N_assigned / length(max_prob),

    N_unassigned =
      length(max_prob) - N_assigned,

    Percent_unassigned =
      100 * N_unassigned / length(max_prob)
  )

threshold_summary


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Number of genes in each current assignment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

table(motif_assignment$Assignment)

prop.table(
  table(motif_assignment$Assignment)
) * 100


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Posterior probability / margin summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summary(motif_assignment$Margin)

quantile(
  motif_assignment$Margin,
  probs = c(
    0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75,
    0.90, 0.95, 0.99, 1
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Examine genes that are just below the 0.5 cutoff
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genes_near_cutoff <- motif_assignment %>%
  filter(
    MaxProb >= 0.44,
    MaxProb <= 0.50
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(MaxProb))

head(
  genes_near_cutoff,
  20
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Examine the posterior probabilities for genes
#    that are unassigned at the 0.5 threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------

unassigned_genes <- motif_assignment %>%
  filter(MaxProb <= 0.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(MaxProb))

head(
  unassigned_genes,
  20
)

# Full CorMotif posterior probabilities for the first
# 20 unassigned genes
motif_prob[
  unassigned_genes$Gene[1:min(20, nrow(unassigned_genes))],
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Summary of assigned vs unassigned genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

motif_assignment %>%
  mutate(
    Assigned = MaxProb > 0.5
  ) %>%
  group_by(Assigned) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    Percent = 100 * N / nrow(motif_assignment),

    Mean_MaxProb = mean(MaxProb),

    Median_MaxProb = median(MaxProb),

    Mean_SecondProb = mean(SecondProb),

    Median_SecondProb = median(SecondProb),

    Mean_Margin = mean(Margin),

    Median_Margin = median(Margin),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Specifically characterize the unassigned genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

unassigned_summary <- motif_assignment %>%
  filter(MaxProb <= 0.5) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    Percent_of_genes =
      100 * N / nrow(motif_assignment),

    Mean_MaxProb =
      mean(MaxProb),

    Median_MaxProb =
      median(MaxProb),

    Mean_SecondProb =
      mean(SecondProb),

    Median_SecondProb =
      median(SecondProb),

    Mean_Margin =
      mean(Margin),

    Median_Margin =
      median(Margin)
  )

unassigned_summary


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Check how many genes have a very clear preferred
#     cluster despite being below the 0.5 cutoff
# ------------------------------------------------------------

unassigned_genes %>%
  mutate(
    Clear_preference = case_when(
      Margin >= 0.30 ~ "Large margin >=0.3",
      Margin >= 0.20 ~ "Moderate margin >=0.2",
      Margin >= 0.10 ~ "Small margin >=0.1",
      TRUE ~ "Highly ambiguous"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Clear_preference) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent =
      100 * n / sum(n)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Final cluster sizes using the 0.5 threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_summary <- motif_assignment %>%
  filter(MaxProb > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::count(Cluster, name = "N_genes") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent_of_assigned =
      100 * N_genes / sum(N_genes),

    Percent_of_all_genes =
      100 * N_genes / nrow(motif_assignment)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cluster)

cluster_summary
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_GOBP, fig.height=3, fig.width=7}

gost_combined <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

top_terms <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP") %>%        # keep only BP terms
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 10) %>%       # top 10 per cluster
  ungroup()

cluster_list <- split(top_terms, top_terms$Cluster)

library(ggplot2)

for (clust_name in names(cluster_list)) {
  
  df <- cluster_list[[clust_name]]
  
  p <- ggplot(df,
              aes(x = Cluster, y = term_name, fill = -log10(p_value))) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick") +
    labs(fill = "-log10(p-value)",
         x = "Cluster",
         y = "GO Term") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
  
  print(p)   # display in RStudio
  
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

top_terms <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP",
         p_value < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster_num = as.numeric(gsub("clust", "", Cluster)),
    term_label = paste0(Cluster, " : ", term_name)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Cluster_num))

top_terms$term_label <- factor(
  top_terms$term_label,
  levels = rev(top_terms$term_label)
)

ggplot(top_terms,
       aes(x = 1,
           y = term_label,
           fill = -log10(p_value))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Cluster), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(fill = "-log10(p-value)",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_GOBPCombined,fig.height=5}

gost_combined <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

sig_thresh <- 0.05

# 1. For each cluster, keep significant terms and max 10 lowest p-values
top_sig_terms_per_cluster <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  filter(p_value < sig_thresh) %>%                    # keep only significant
  slice_min(order_by = p_value, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  # max 10 per cluster
  ungroup()

# 2. Keep all unique terms across clusters
unique_terms <- unique(top_sig_terms_per_cluster$term_name)

# 3. Filter original gost_combined for these terms, retain p-values from all clusters
heatmap_data <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP", term_name %in% unique_terms) %>%
  mutate(logp = -log10(p_value)) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, logp)

# 4. Pivot to wide format for matrix-style heatmap
heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, values_from = logp)

saveRDS(heatmap_wide, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

heatmap_wide <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

# 5. Convert to long format for ggplot
heatmap_long <- heatmap_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -term_name, names_to = "Cluster", values_to = "logp")

saveRDS(heatmap_long, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoLong_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

heatmap_long <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoLong_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

# 6. Plot heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = Cluster, y = term_name, fill = logp)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick", na.value = "white") +
  labs(fill = "-log10(p-value)", x = "Cluster", y = "GO Term") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

heatmap_wide <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# Prepare the matrix for clustering: rows = terms, columns = clusters
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "term_name") %>%   # rows = GO terms
  as.matrix()

# Optional: replace NAs with 0 for clustering (or leave NA if you want)
heatmap_matrix[is.na(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

sig_matrix <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(
    source == "GO:BP",
    term_name %in% unique_terms
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster,
    values_from = sig,
    values_fill = ""
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create clustered heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "GO:BP Enrichment Heatmap",
  display_numbers = sig_matrix,
  number_color = "black"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

# Use your existing normalized log2CPM matrix
log2cpm <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/TACC/ToCormotif/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No4_TMM.RDS")

# Metadata: one row per sample
meta <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata_No4_NoRep.RDS")

meta <- meta[ match(colnames(log2cpm), meta$SampleName), ]

# Keep the five developmental stages
stages <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

# Adjust these column names if needed
meta <- meta %>%
  filter(
    Timepoint %in% stages,
    Species %in% c("H", "C")
  )

# Long-format expression matrix
expr_long <- as.data.frame(log2cpm) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Gene,
    names_to = "SampleName",
    values_to = "log2CPM"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(meta, by = "SampleName")

# Mean expression per gene, species, and stage
mean_expr <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(Gene, Species, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_log2CPM = mean(log2CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Consecutive developmental transitions
transitions <- tibble(
  From = stages[-length(stages)],
  To = stages[-1]
)

# Calculate changes for each gene and species
changes <- mean_expr %>%
  arrange(Gene, Species, match(Timepoint, stages)) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Species) %>%
  mutate(
    From = Timepoint,
    To = lead(Timepoint),
    Delta = lead(Mean_log2CPM) - Mean_log2CPM
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(To),
    match(To, stages) == match(From, stages) + 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Gene, Species, From, To, Delta)
```


```{r}
change_compare <- changes %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = Delta
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(H), is.finite(C))

cor_results <- change_compare %>%
  group_by(From, To) %>%
  summarise(
    N_genes = n(),
    Spearman = cor(H, C, method = "spearman"),
    Same_direction = mean(sign(H) == sign(C)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_results

ggplot(change_compare, aes(x = H, y = C)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ From + To, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Human change in mean log2CPM",
    y = "Chimpanzee change in mean log2CPM",
    title = "Concordance of developmental expression changes"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

clust_names_list <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/RNA_TMM_clust_names_list_Trajectory.RDS")

library(purrr)

# Add CorMotif cluster membership to the expression-change data
cluster_changes <- imap_dfr(

  ~ change_compare %>%

)

# Calculate concordance for each cluster and transition
cluster_cor_results <- cluster_changes %>%
  group_by(Cluster, From, To) %>%
  summarise(
    N_genes = n(),
    Spearman = cor(H, C, method = "spearman"),
    Same_direction = mean(sign(H) == sign(C)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cluster, From)

cluster_cor_results

transition_order <- c(
  "Day0-Day2",
  "Day2-Day5",
  "Day5-Day15",
  "Day15-Day30"
)

cluster_cor_results <- cluster_cor_results %>%
  mutate(
    Transition = factor(
      paste(From, To, sep = "-"),
      levels = transition_order
    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Set the developmental transition order
transition_levels <- c(
  "Day0-Day2",
  "Day2-Day5",
  "Day5-Day15",
  "Day15-Day30"
)

plot_data <- cluster_response_results %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = as.character(1:13)),
    Transition = factor(
      paste(From, To, sep = "-"),
      levels = transition_levels
    )
  )

# Helper function to create a heatmap
make_response_heatmap <- function(data, metric, legend_title,
                                  low, mid, high, midpoint = NULL) {

  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(x = Transition, y = Cluster, fill = .data[[metric]])
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", .data[[metric]])),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = low,
      mid = mid,
      high = high,
      midpoint = midpoint,
      name = legend_title
    ) +
    labs(x = "Developmental transition", y = "CorMotif cluster") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  p
}

# A. Spearman correlation of expression changes
p_spearman <- make_response_heatmap(
  plot_data,
  metric = "Spearman",
  legend_title = "Spearman\ncorrelation",
  low = "#B2182B",
  mid = "white",
  high = "#2166AC",
  midpoint = 0
)

# B. Proportion of genes changing in the same direction
p_direction <- make_response_heatmap(
  plot_data,
  metric = "Same_direction",
  legend_title = "Same direction",
  low = "#B2182B",
  mid = "white",
  high = "#2166AC",
  midpoint = 0.5
)

# C. Median absolute difference in expression changes
p_difference <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = Transition, y = Cluster, fill = Median_Abs_Difference)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Median_Abs_Difference)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#762A83",
    name = "Median absolute\ndifference"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Developmental transition", y = "CorMotif cluster") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Display
p_spearman
p_direction
p_difference

# Save high-resolution figures
ggsave("Cluster_Spearman_heatmap.pdf", p_spearman, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("Cluster_Direction_heatmap.pdf", p_direction, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("Cluster_Magnitude_heatmap.pdf", p_difference, width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_CorMotif_Trajectory_TACC_ClusterAssign3}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

prob_cols <- paste0("V", 1:12)

# =========================================================
# Calculate max probability, second-highest probability,
# and margin for every gene
# =========================================================

motif_margin <- motif_prob %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    MaxProb = max(c_across(all_of(prob_cols))),
    
    SecondProb = sort(
      c_across(all_of(prob_cols)),
      decreasing = TRUE
    )[2],
    
    MaxCluster = which.max(
      c_across(all_of(prob_cols))
    ),
    
    Margin = MaxProb - SecondProb
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# =========================================================
# Assign genes using YOUR ORIGINAL RULE
#
# One cluster must have >0.5 AND all other clusters <0.5
# =========================================================

motif_margin <- motif_margin %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    N_above_05 = sum(
      c_across(all_of(prob_cols)) > 0.5
    ),
    
    Assigned = N_above_05 == 1,
    
    Cluster = ifelse(
      Assigned,
      paste0("clust", MaxCluster),
      "Unassigned"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# =========================================================
# Check assignment numbers
# =========================================================

assignment_summary <- motif_margin %>%
  dplyr::count(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )

assignment_summary


# =========================================================
# Margin statistics by group
# Includes Unassigned
# =========================================================

margin_stats <- motif_margin %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = mean(Margin),
    Median = median(Margin),
    SD = sd(Margin),
    Min = min(Margin),
    Q1 = quantile(Margin, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(Margin, 0.75),
    Max = max(Margin),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

margin_stats


# =========================================================
# Set cluster order
# =========================================================

cluster_order <- c(
  paste0("clust", 1:12),
  "Unassigned"
)

motif_margin$Cluster <- factor(
  motif_margin$Cluster,
  levels = cluster_order
)


# =========================================================
# Plot margin distributions
# =========================================================

ggplot(
  motif_margin,
  aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Margin
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "CorMotif group",
    y = "Margin (maximum posterior − second-highest posterior)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Optional: categorize the margins
# =========================================================

motif_margin <- motif_margin %>%
  mutate(
    Margin_Category = case_when(
      Margin >= 0.30 ~ "Large margin > 0.3",
      Margin >= 0.20 & Margin < 0.30 ~ "Moderate margin 0.2 - 0.3",
      Margin >= 0.10 & Margin < 0.20 ~ "Small margin 0.1 - 0.2",
      Margin < 0.10 ~ "Unclear < 0.1"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Margin-category statistics by CorMotif group
# Includes Unassigned
# =========================================================

margin_category_stats <- motif_margin %>%
  dplyr::count(Cluster, Margin_Category, name = "N") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = 100 * N / sum(N)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

margin_category_stats

# =========================================================
# 100% stacked bar plot of margin categories
# =========================================================

ggplot(
  margin_category_stats,
  aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Percent,
    fill = Margin_Category
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = "stack",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "CorMotif group",
    y = "Genes (%)",
    fill = "Margin"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_KEGGCombined, fig.height=5}

TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
ComparisonNames <- readRDS("data/DGE/ComparisonNames_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNAsets_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
clust_names_list <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/RNA_TMM_clust_names_list_Trajectory.RDS")


Traj_levels <- c("Day02", "Day25", "Day515", "Day1530")

library(stringr)

TopTable <- TopTable %>%
  mutate(
    Species = str_extract(Comparisons, "^[A-Za-z]+"),
    Day     = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day\\d+")
  ) 
  

make_alluvial_plots <- function(genes, testing, TopTable, Traj_levels) {

  df <- TopTable %>%
    filter(Day %in% Traj_levels, Gene %in% genes) %>%
    mutate(Day = factor(Day, levels = Traj_levels)) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c("H", "C"))) %>%
    mutate(
  Direction = case_when(
      logFC > 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05  ~ "Sig - UP",
      logFC < 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Sig - Down",
      adj.P.Val > 0.05       ~ "NS"
    )) %>% 
  mutate(
    Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Sig - UP", "NS", "Sig - Down")
))

  fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sig - UP" = "red", "Sig - Down" = "blue", "NS" = "grey80"))

  p_facet <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = Day, stratum = Direction, alluvium = Gene, y = 1, fill = Direction)
  ) +
    geom_flow(aes.bind = "flows", stat = "alluvium", decreasing = NA, reverse = TRUE) + 
    geom_stratum(decreasing = NA, reverse = TRUE) + 
    facet_wrap(~ Species) +
    fill_scale +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of genes", title = paste0("Cluster ", testing))

  p_combined <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = Day, stratum = Direction, alluvium = interaction(Gene, Species), y = 1, fill = Direction)
  ) +
    geom_flow(aes.bind = "flows", stat = "alluvium", decreasing = NA, reverse = FALSE) + 
    geom_stratum(decreasing = NA, reverse = FALSE) + 
    fill_scale +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of genes", title = paste0("Cluster ", testing))

  list(facet = p_facet, combined = p_combined)
}

all_alluvial_plots <- imap(clust_names_list, ~ make_alluvial_plots(.x, .y, TopTable, Traj_levels))

walk(all_alluvial_plots, ~ print(.x$facet))
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_CorMotif_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler2}
motif.fitted <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/TACC/Trajectory/CorMotif_k1_k20_seed8_TMM_No4.rds")
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")


clust_names_list <- list(
  "1" = clust1_RNA,
  "2" = clust2_RNA,
  "3" = clust3_RNA,
  "4" = clust4_RNA,
  "5" = clust5_RNA,
  "6" = clust6_RNA,
  "7" = clust7_RNA,
  "8" = clust8_RNA,
  "9" = clust9_RNA,
  "10" = clust10_RNA,
  "11" = clust11_RNA,
  "12" = clust12_RNA,
  "13" = clust13_RNA
)

all_genes <- unique(TopTable$Gene)


convert_to_entrez_df <- function(genes) {

  genes <- sub("\\..*", "", genes)

  bitr(
    genes,
    fromType = "ENSEMBL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  ) %>% distinct()
}

background_entrez <- convert_to_entrez_df(all_genes)$ENTREZID

gost_results <- setNames(

  lapply(names(clust_names_list), function(clust_name) {

    genes <- clust_names_list[[clust_name]]

    entrez_df <- convert_to_entrez_df(genes)

    if (nrow(entrez_df) == 0) return(NULL)

    gost(
      query = entrez_df$ENTREZID,

      organism = "hsapiens",

      significant = FALSE,
      ordered_query = FALSE,         # TRUE only if ranked
      domain_scope = "custom",

      measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
      evcodes = FALSE,

      numeric_ns = "ENTREZGENE",

      user_threshold = 0.05,
      correction_method = "fdr",

      custom_bg = background_entrez,

      sources = c("GO:BP", "KEGG")
    )
  }),

  names(clust_names_list)
)

saveRDS(gost_results, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

gost_results <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

gost_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(gost_results), function(clust_name) {

  res <- gost_results[[clust_name]]

  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  df <- res$result
  df$Cluster <- clust_name
  df
}))

saveRDS(gost_combined, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

gost_combined <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

gost_export <- gost_combined

gost_export[] <- lapply(gost_export, function(col) {

  if (is.list(col)) {
    sapply(col, paste, collapse = ";")
  } else {
    col
  }

})

write.csv(gost_export,
          "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.csv",
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_GOBPCombined, fig.width=7 ,fig.height=7}
gost_combined <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

sig_thresh <- 0.05

# 1. For each cluster, keep significant terms and max 10 lowest p-values
top_sig_terms_per_cluster <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  filter(p_value < sig_thresh) %>%                    # keep only significant
  slice_min(order_by = p_value, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  # max 10 per cluster
  ungroup()

# 2. Keep all unique terms across clusters
unique_terms <- unique(top_sig_terms_per_cluster$term_name)

# 3. Filter original gost_combined for these terms, retain p-values from all clusters
heatmap_data <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP", term_name %in% unique_terms) %>%
  mutate(logp = -log10(p_value)) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, logp)

# 4. Pivot to wide format for matrix-style heatmap
heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, values_from = logp)

saveRDS(heatmap_wide, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

# 5. Convert to long format for ggplot
heatmap_long <- heatmap_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -term_name, names_to = "Cluster", values_to = "logp")

saveRDS(heatmap_long, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoLong_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

heatmap_long <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoLong_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

# 6. Plot heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = Cluster, y = term_name, fill = logp)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick", na.value = "white") +
  labs(fill = "-log10(p-value)", x = "Cluster", y = "GO Term") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

heatmap_wide <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# Prepare the matrix for clustering: rows = terms, columns = clusters
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "term_name") %>%   # rows = GO terms
  as.matrix()

# Optional: replace NAs with 0 for clustering (or leave NA if you want)

sig_matrix <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(
    source == "GO:BP",
    term_name %in% unique_terms
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster,
    values_from = sig,
    values_fill = ""
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%

  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),

  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "GO:BP Enrichment Heatmap",
  display_numbers = sig_matrix,
  number_color = "black"
)
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_CorMotif_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler3}
motif.fitted <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/TACC/Trajectory/CorMotif_k1_k20_seed8_TMM_No4.rds")
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")

Traj_levels <- c("Day02", "Day25", "Day515", "Day1530")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Process your TopTable and make a clean descriptive column for each comparison
processed_table <- TopTable %>%
  mutate(
    Species = str_extract(Comparisons, "^[A-Za-z]+"),
    Day     = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day\\d+")
  ) %>%
  filter(Day %in% Traj_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = factor(Day, levels = Traj_levels),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("H", "C")),
    Direction = case_when(
      logFC > 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Sig - UP",
      logFC < 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Sig - Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS" # Clean fallback catch-all
    ),
    Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Sig - UP", "NS", "Sig - Down")),
    
    # Create a unified name for each specific column (e.g., "H_Day15")
    Comp_Label = paste(Species, Day, sep = "_")
  ) %>% 
  filter(Gene %in% clust8_RNA)

# 2. Pivot wide and count the unique combination intersections
combination_counts <- processed_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Comp_Label, Direction) %>%
  
  # Reshape so every H/C Day condition is its own column
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Comp_Label, 
    values_from = Direction, 
    values_fill = "NS" # If a gene isn't listed for a timepoint, it defaults to Not Significant
  ) %>%
  
  # Count how many genes share the exact same up/down grid pattern
  # The "..." tells R to count using every column except the 'Gene' column
  dplyr::count(across(-Gene), sort = TRUE)

# View the output table
print(n=30,combination_counts)


```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_CorMotif_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler4}
convert_to_entrez_df <- function(genes) {

  genes <- sub("\\..*", "", genes)

  bitr(
    genes,
    fromType = "ENSEMBL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  ) %>% distinct()
}

background_entrez <- convert_to_entrez_df(all_genes)$ENTREZID

gost_results <- setNames(

  lapply(names(clust_names_list_Subsetting), function(clust_name) {

    genes <- clust_names_list_Subsetting[[clust_name]]

    entrez_df <- convert_to_entrez_df(genes)

    if (nrow(entrez_df) == 0) return(NULL)

    gost(
      query = entrez_df$ENTREZID,

      organism = "hsapiens",

      significant = FALSE,
      ordered_query = FALSE,         # TRUE only if ranked
      domain_scope = "custom",

      measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
      evcodes = FALSE,

      numeric_ns = "ENTREZGENE",

      user_threshold = 0.05,
      correction_method = "fdr",

      custom_bg = background_entrez,

      sources = c("GO:BP", "KEGG")
    )
  }),

  names(clust_names_list)
)
```

```{r KZFP_Species_FC_lineplot}

log2cpm <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/TACC/ToCormotif/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_log2cpm_No4_TMM.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Reshape wide log2cpm data into long format
log2cpm_long <- log2cpm %>%
  # Make the rownames an explicit column first
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>%
  # Pivot all sample columns down
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Gene, 
    names_to = "Sample", 
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  
  # 2. Parse out strings using the constant "_Day" anchor
  mutate(
    # Extract the very first letter (H or C)
    Species = str_extract(Sample, "^[HC]"),
    
    # Split "H21792_Day15" on "_Day" -> returns a matrix with ["H21792", "15"]
    # We grab the second column to get the raw timepoint number cleanly
    Day_num = str_split_fixed(Sample, "_Day", 2)[, 2],
    
    # Reassemble back into "DayX" format (e.g., "Day15")
    Day = paste0("Day", Day_num)
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Factorize your time column to match your tracking trajectory order
  mutate(
    Day = factor(Day, levels = day_levels)
  ) %>%
  
  # Drop the intermediate cleaning column
  select(-Day_num)


library(ggplot2)

# Filter and add tracking metadata
plot_data <- log2cpm_long %>%
  # Keep only the genes in your cluster (e.g., clust2_RNA)
  filter(Gene %in% clust2_RNA_UP) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_label = stringr::str_extract(Species, "^[HC]")
  )


ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Day,
    y = Expression,
    group = Gene
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  
  # Split the plot side-by-side or stacked to cleanly contrast Human vs Chimp trajectories
  facet_wrap(~ Species_label) + 
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Expression (log2 CPM)",
    title = "Human vs. Chimpanzee Cluster Expression Trajectories"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

library(dplyr)

plot_means_data <- log2cpm_long %>%
  # 1. Filter for only your cluster's genes
  filter(Gene %in% clust2_RNA_UP) %>%
  
  # 2. Collapse individual replicates into a mean value per condition
  group_by(Gene, Species, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Expression = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Create descriptive labels for the side-by-side plot layout
  mutate(
    Species_label = if_else(Species == "H", "Human", "Chimpanzee")
  )

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  plot_means_data,
  aes(
    x = Day,
    y = Mean_Expression,
    group = Gene # Keeps each gene as a separate line
  )
) +
  # Single color for all lines to view global trajectory patterns
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Facet side-by-side by species
  facet_wrap(~ Species_label) + 
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Mean Expression (log2 CPM)",
    title = "Human vs. Chimpanzee Cluster Expression Trajectories",
    subtitle = "Data averaged across biological replicates"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_GOBP3, fig.width=10 ,fig.height=20}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

top_terms <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(
    source == "GO:BP",
    p_value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Keep Cluster clean, but strip "clust" for sorting
    Cluster_clean = gsub("clust", "", Cluster),
    term_label = paste0(Cluster, " : ", term_name)
  ) %>%
  # Safely drops exact duplicate labels within the same cluster
  distinct(term_label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  # Sort naturally (e.g., 12U -> 12D -> 12 -> 11U...)
  arrange(desc(gtools::mixedorder(Cluster_clean)), p_value) %>% 
  # Safely convert to a factor based on this exact row order
  mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_rev(forcats::fct_inorder(term_label)))


ggplot(top_terms,
       aes(x = 1,
           y = term_label,
           fill = -log10(p_value))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Cluster), size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(fill = "-log10(p-value)",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_GOBPCombined2, fig.width=7 ,fig.height=10}

gost_combined <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoCombo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep_Subsetting.RDS")



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

sig_thresh <- 0.05

# 1. For each cluster, keep significant terms and max 10 lowest p-values
top_sig_terms_per_cluster <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  filter(p_value < sig_thresh) %>%                    
  slice_min(order_by = p_value, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  
  ungroup()

# 2. Keep all unique terms across clusters
unique_terms <- unique(top_sig_terms_per_cluster$term_name)

# 3. Filter and DEDUPLICATE by taking the max significance
heatmap_data <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(source == "GO:BP", term_name %in% unique_terms) %>%
  mutate(logp = -log10(p_value)) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, logp) %>%
  # NEW STEP: If a term appears twice in a cluster, keep the highest -log10(p-value)
  group_by(Cluster, term_name) %>%
  summarise(logp = max(logp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4. Pivot to wide format (will now cleanly yield a numeric matrix instead of lists)
heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, values_from = logp)

saveRDS(heatmap_wide, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

# 5. Convert to long format for ggplot (logp will now be a proper numeric vector)
heatmap_long <- heatmap_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -term_name, names_to = "Cluster", values_to = "logp")

saveRDS(heatmap_long, "data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoLong_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

# 6. Plot heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = Cluster, y = term_name, fill = logp)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick", na.value = "white") +
  labs(fill = "-log10(p-value)", x = "Cluster", y = "GO Term") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))


heatmap_wide <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryGoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# Prepare the matrix for clustering: rows = terms, columns = clusters
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "term_name") %>%   # rows = GO terms
  as.matrix()

# Optional: replace NAs with 0 for clustering (or leave NA if you want)
heatmap_matrix[is.na(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

sig_matrix <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(
    source == "GO:BP",
    term_name %in% unique_terms
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, sig) %>%
  # NEW STEP: Deduplicate rows. If there's a "*" in any duplicate row, pick it.
  group_by(Cluster, term_name) %>%
  summarise(
    sig = if_else(any(sig == "*"), "*", ""), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Pivot will now run flawlessly
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster,
    values_from = sig,
    values_fill = ""
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create clustered heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "GO:BP Enrichment Heatmap",
  display_numbers = sig_matrix,
  number_color = "black"
)
```

```{r RNA-Seq_No4_TMM_Trajectory_TACC_GProfiler_KEGGCombined3, fig.height=5}
heatmap_wide <- readRDS("data/Cormotif/Trajectory/TrajectoryKEGGWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_TMM_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# Prepare the matrix for clustering: rows = terms, columns = clusters
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "term_name") %>%   # rows = GO terms
  as.matrix()

# Optional: replace NAs with 0 for clustering (or leave NA if you want)
heatmap_matrix[is.na(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

sig_matrix <- gost_combined %>%
  filter(
    source == "KEGG",
    term_name %in% unique_terms
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  select(Cluster, term_name, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster,
    values_from = sig,
    values_fill = ""
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create clustered heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "KEGG Enrichment Heatmap",
  display_numbers = sig_matrix,
  number_color = "black"
)
```

#### Spearman Coefficients

```{r Spearman_Correlation, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata_No4_NoRep.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata_No4_NoRep.RDS")
fc <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No4.RDS")

gene_sets <- list(
  Cluster1 = clust1_RNA,
  Cluster2 = clust2_RNA,
  Cluster3 = clust3_RNA,
  Cluster4 = clust4_RNA,
  Cluster5 = clust5_RNA,
  Cluster6 = clust6_RNA,
  Cluster7 = clust7_RNA,
  Cluster8 = clust8_RNA,
  Cluster9 = clust9_RNA,
  Cluster10 = clust10_RNA,
  Cluster11 = clust11_RNA,
  Cluster12 = clust12_RNA
)

results <- list()

for (i in seq_along(gene_sets)) {

  gene_set <- gene_sets[[i]]
  cluster_name <- names(gene_sets)[i]

  print(cluster_name)
  print(length(gene_set))

  # Keep genes in cluster
  counts <- fc[rownames(fc) %in% gene_set, ]

  # Metadata
  metadata_i <- RNA_Metadata

  metadata_i <- metadata_i[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata_i$SampleName),
  ]

  metadata_i <- metadata_i %>%
    filter(Individual != "H4R") %>%
    filter(Timepoint != "Day4")

  counts <- counts %>%
    dplyr::select(-contains("R")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-contains("Day4"))

  # Group labels
  metadata_i$dgelist <- c(
    rep(c(
      "Human_Day0",
      "Human_Day2",
      "Human_Day5",
      "Human_Day15",
      "Human_Day30",
      "Chimp_Day0",
      "Chimp_Day2",
      "Chimp_Day5",
      "Chimp_Day15",
      "Chimp_Day30"
    ), 7)
  )

  # DGEList
  dge <- DGEList(counts = counts)

  dge$samples$group <- factor(metadata_i$dgelist)

  dge <- calcNormFactors(
    dge,
    method = "TMM"
  )

  # log2 CPM
  log2cpm <- cpm(
    dge,
    log = TRUE
  )

  # Match metadata
  metadata_i <- metadata_i[
    match(
      colnames(log2cpm),
      metadata_i$SampleName
    ),
  ]

  stopifnot(
    all(
      metadata_i$SampleName ==
        colnames(log2cpm)
    )
  )

  stopifnot(
    !any(
      is.na(metadata_i$SampleName)
    )
  )

  # Correlation
  Cor_log2cpm <- cor(
    log2cpm,
    method = "spearman"
  )

  # Sample information
  sample_info <- data.frame(
    sample = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
    species = metadata_i$Species,
    timepoint = metadata_i$Timepoint
  )

  # Long format
  cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
    mutate(
      sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      -sample1,
      names_to = "sample2",
      values_to = "cor"
    ) %>%
    filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
    left_join(
      sample_info,
      by = c("sample1" = "sample")
    ) %>%
    rename(
      species1 = species,
      timepoint1 = timepoint
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      sample_info,
      by = c("sample2" = "sample")
    ) %>%
    rename(
      species2 = species,
      timepoint2 = timepoint
    )

  # Same-day cross-species
  same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
    filter(
      species1 != species2,
      timepoint1 == timepoint2
    ) %>%
    filter(species1 == "H") %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint1 = factor(
        timepoint1,
        levels = c(
          "Day0",
          "Day2",
          "Day5",
          "Day15",
          "Day30"
        )
      )
    )

  # Summary
  summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
    group_by(timepoint1) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_cor = median(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Kruskal-Wallis
  kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
    cor ~ timepoint1,
    data = same_day_cross
  )

  # Pairwise Wilcoxon
  stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
    pairwise_wilcox_test(
      cor ~ timepoint1,
      p.adjust.method = "BH"
    ) %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_y_position() %>%
    filter(p.adj <= 0.05)

  # Save results
  results[[cluster_name]] <- list(
    genes = gene_set,
    n_genes = length(gene_set),
    same_day_cross = same_day_cross,
    summary = summary_by_day,
    kruskal = kruskal_res,
    pairwise = stat.test
  )
}

# Combine cluster summaries
all_cluster_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(results), function(cluster_name) {

    results[[cluster_name]]$summary %>%
      mutate(cluster = cluster_name)

  })
)

# Plot each cluster individually
for (cluster_name in names(results)) {

  plot_data <- results[[cluster_name]]$same_day_cross
  stat.test <- results[[cluster_name]]$pairwise

  plot <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = timepoint1,
      y = cor
    )
  ) +

    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      aes(group = 1),
      fun = median,
      geom = "line",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "point",
      size = 3
    ) +

    stat_pvalue_manual(
      stat.test,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      step.increase = 0.07
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Cross-species correlation -",
        cluster_name
      ),
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = "Median Spearman correlation"
    ) +

    theme_classic()

  print(plot)
}

# Plot all clusters together
plot_all <- ggplot(
  all_cluster_summary,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = median_cor,
    group = cluster,
    color = cluster
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    size = 2
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species correlation across CorMotif clusters",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Median Spearman correlation",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot_all
```
